export.title: Export everything
export.intro: One encrypted file with everything that isn't in git: accounts, FDC polls, the recycling bin, avatars, logs, bot data and .env.
export.differences: {{count}} file(s) have a different creation time than recorded (copied or restored). Their recorded time is used.
export.keyHint: Needed again for safety. It is also the password of the file (user name "admin").
export.done: Saved {{name}} ({{size}}, {{files}} files). Keep it somewhere safe.

import.safety: Safety backup of the previous state: {{file}}

report.units: {{count}} file group(s) taken from the backup

import.restart: Restart the bot and the account API so they load the imported data.
import.title: Import a backup
import.intro: Checking a backup changes nothing. You see exactly what would happen first, and before anything is applied a safety backup of everything is saved.
import.otherKey: The backup was made with a different admin key
import.mergeText: From another machine: combine both. Points and levels take the higher value, nothing is thrown away.
import.restoreText: Roll back after an error: the backup's versions win, including exact points and levels.
import.modeSinceExport: Backup wins, but keep my changes made after the backup
import.usersNote: Same Discord user on both sides: one account, the oldest ID is kept. Logins (sessions) are not imported; people just log in again.
import.envNote: Comments are ignored. Values that only exist here are always kept.
import.safeNote: Nothing is lost: everything that would be replaced goes into a safety backup on the server first (the last 5 are kept).
import.applying: Saving a safety backup and importing…

activity.backup-longer: Activity log: the backup has newer entries; they are added
activity.local-longer: Activity log: this one is newer; kept
activity.different: Activity log: different histories; the current one is kept and the backup's is saved next to it

title: Backup & restore
intro: Everything the site and the bots store, in one safe file. Only the admin account can use this page.
adminOnly: Only the admin account (log in with the admin code) can use backups.

unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.text2fa: Enter the admin key and the current code from your authenticator app. The page stays unlocked for 15 minutes of activity.
unlock.text: Enter the admin key. Tip: turn on 2FA (pnpm 2fa:setup on the server, ADMIN_2FA=on) for extra safety.
